home.metaDesc: Free Twitch chat bot with Spotify song requests, moderation that runs itself, custom commands, timers, and game stats. Every tool free forever, set up in minutes.
sr.metaDesc: Free Spotify song requests for Twitch. Viewers type !sr in chat and the track lands in your real Spotify queue. No premium gate, no card, set up in about two minutes.
sr.title: Your chat picks the soundtrack.
sr.lead: Viewers type !sr in chat and the track lands in your real Spotify queue. Free, forever, no premium gate.
sr.howTitle: Three steps, then it runs itself.
sr.step1Desc: Bring your own Spotify application: create it once in Spotify's developer dashboard, paste the credentials on the Song Requests page, and they are sealed on our side, never exposed.
sr.step2Desc: Viewers type !sr with a song name or a Spotify link. The bot resolves the track and adds it to the queue.
sr.step3Desc: Requests drive your actual Spotify player, so queue positions stay in sync with what is really playing. No separate in-browser playlist.
sr.cmd1Desc: Request a song by name or Spotify link.
sr.cmd3Desc: Skip the track that is playing.
sr.cmd4Desc: Say what is playing right now.
sr.limitsNote: Per-viewer limits, queue caps and moderator skip controls all live in the dashboard.
sr.faqQ1: How do viewers request a song on Twitch?
sr.faqA1: They type !sr followed by a song name or a Spotify link in chat. ItsBagelBot resolves the track and adds it to the streamer's Spotify queue.
sr.faqA2: Yes. Requests drive the streamer's actual Spotify player, so queue positions stay in sync with what is really playing. It is not a separate in-browser playlist.
sr.faqA3: Yes. Song requests are part of the free tier, forever. Premium only buys message priority, never features.
sr.faqA4: Yes. Per-viewer limits, queue caps and moderator skip controls, all configured in the dashboard.
sr.faqQ5: What does it cost the streamer?
sr.faqA5: Nothing. A Spotify account that can play music is the only requirement.
sr.faqQ6: I already use another bot. Do I have to start over?
sr.faqA6: No. The import wizard brings your commands, timers, counters and quotes over from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot or Streamlabs Chatbot, and you review every item before it is written.
vp.metaTitle: Valorant Stats & Rank Command for Twitch - ItsBagelBot
vp.metaDesc: Free Valorant rank command for Twitch chat. !valrank shows rank and RR, !valmatches lists recent competitive games, !valshop shows the daily store. Part of ItsBagelBot, free forever.
vp.title: Your rank, asked and answered.
vp.lead: Viewers type !valrank and chat sees your rank, RR and recent games. No alt-tab, no overlay.
vp.howTitle: Turn it on once, answer forever.
vp.step1Desc: Valorant stats are an opt-in module: switch it on from the dashboard and link the Riot ID it should answer for.
vp.step2Desc: Anyone can type the commands; per-command cooldowns keep busy chats from spamming them.
vp.step3Desc: Stats are fetched on demand from public Valorant data services and cached briefly, so answers stay fast even mid-raid. Nothing runs on the gaming PC.
vp.cmd6Desc: The catch-all: one command, subcommands for everything above.
vp.limitsNote: The module is opt-in per channel and every command carries a cooldown.
vp.faqQ1: How do I show my Valorant rank in Twitch chat?
vp.faqA1: Enable the Valorant module from the ItsBagelBot dashboard, link your Riot ID, and viewers can type !valrank in chat. The bot answers with your current rank and RR.
vp.faqQ2: Does it need an overlay or anything on my gaming PC?
vp.faqA2: No. It is a chat command. The bot fetches stats from public Valorant data services on its own servers; nothing is installed or captured on your machine.
vp.faqA3: Yes. Game stats are part of the free tier, forever. Premium only buys message priority, never features.
vp.faqQ4: Can I keep chat from spamming it?
vp.faqA4: Every command has a cooldown, and the whole module is opt-in, so it only answers in channels that turned it on.
vp.ctaTitle: Let chat check the rank themselves.
vp.legal: ItsBagelBot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
imp.metaTitle: Switch from Nightbot or StreamElements - ItsBagelBot
imp.metaDesc: Import your Twitch bot setup in minutes. The wizard brings commands, timers, counters and quotes over from Nightbot, StreamElements, Moobot or Streamlabs Chatbot, and you review every item before it is written.
imp.title: Bring your setup with you.
imp.lead: Commands, timers, counters and quotes come over from your current bot. You review every item before it lands.
imp.step1Desc: Nightbot connects over OAuth. StreamElements, Moobot and Streamlabs Chatbot hand you an export file, and the wizard reads it right in the browser.
imp.step2Desc: Every command, timer, counter and quote is listed before it is written. Keep, skip, or adjust each one; nothing lands silently.
imp.step3Desc: Approved items are written to your channel and the bot starts answering. Your old bot is untouched; retire it whenever you are ready.
imp.src1Desc: Connects over OAuth, no file needed.
imp.limitsNote: Export files are parsed in the browser; nothing is written to your channel until you approve it.
imp.faqA1: Commands, timers, counters and quotes. The wizard shows the full list from your export and you decide item by item.
imp.faqQ2: Do I have to remove my old bot first?
imp.faqA2: No. The import never touches your old bot. Run both while you test and part ways when you are ready.
imp.faqQ3: Will my command responses survive the move?
imp.faqA3: The wizard translates what it can into ItsBagelBot's variable system and shows you the result before anything is written, so nothing lands silently broken.
imp.faqA4: Yes. The import wizard, like everything else, is part of the free tier.
imp.ctaTitle: Two minutes and your setup is home.

faq.title: Fair questions.
faq.q1: Is the free plan really free?
faq.a1: Yes. Every feature, and it stays that way. I built it because good tools shouldn't depend on your budget.
faq.q2: So what am I actually paying for with Premium?
faq.a2: Priority. Premium messages jump to the front of the line, so commands and moderation land faster when chat is busiest. It keeps the servers running, too.
faq.a3: One click from the dashboard. You keep the perks until the end of the billing period you already paid for.
faq.a4: Dedicated hardware, multi-streamer management, custom terms, and direct engineering support. Write to enterprise@itsbagelbot.com for a quote.
faq.a5: ItsBagelBot's source is on GitHub under a source-available licence, which is not the same as open source. You can read and audit every line, but the licence limits redistribution and commercial use.

safe.title: What happens before a message reaches chat.
safe.juryDesc: Independent classifiers each score the message for spam and hate signals. It is only removed when they agree.
safe.gatesDesc: Rate, shape and link checks run first. They are fast and predictable, and they catch floods and known-bad links before anything heavier runs.
safe.networkTitle: One raid warns every protected channel.
safe.networkDesc: A raid pattern seen in one channel is flagged for every enrolled channel, so the second target is already covered.
steps.title: One Twitch login and you're running.
steps.s1Body: One click through Twitch. No API keys, and the whole thing takes about two minutes.
steps.s2Body: Turn on the modules you want and write your rules in plain sentences.
steps.s3Body: It joins your chat quietly and gets to work. You get to just stream.
letter.line1: I started building this after a stream where four tools broke in one night. Chat scrolled past faster than I could moderate, the song queue died, and the giveaway picked nobody.
letter.line2: Every feature in here exists because I needed it at 2 a.m. and couldn't find it, couldn't afford it, or didn't trust where the data went.
letter.line3: Nothing here is sold to advertisers, and nothing is held back for a paid tier. If it makes one stream calmer, it's doing its job.
finale.title: Set it up tonight, stream calmer tomorrow.
finale.sub: Every tool is free. You're live in about two minutes.
finale.honesty: uninstall from the dashboard whenever you want
